overview: Video game designers decide how a game plays. They create core features, storylines and characters, design levels, missions and puzzles, and balance gameplay so it stays fun and fair. O*NET rates their artistic interest at 6.38 out of 7 and knowledge of design at 4.26 out of 5. Most hold a bachelor's degree, 55% in O*NET data, though a strong portfolio often counts more. BLS reports pay only for the broader web and digital interface designers group, with a median of $104,000. The job is desk-based, with long hours near launch dates.
pay: BLS does not publish pay for game designers alone; these figures are for the broader web and digital interface designers group. Its median is $104,000, and the top 10% earn $201,550 or more. California has the most of these jobs, 27,090, and the highest state median, $136,110, 31% above the national figure.

faq.q: How much do video game designers make?
faq.a: BLS reports pay for the broader web and digital interface designers group: a May 2025 median of $104,000. The middle half earn between $73,290 and $158,820. California, Washington ($130,480) and New York ($120,990), where large studios are based, have the highest state medians.

faq.q: Do you need a degree to be a game designer?
faq.a: Not always, but it helps. In O*NET data, 55% of game designers hold a bachelor's degree and 15% a high school diploma. There are 12 related majors, including digital media and computer science. Studios look closely at your portfolio and any games you have made.

faq.q: Is video game design a stressful job?
faq.a: It can be. In O*NET data the job ranks above 99% of U.S. jobs for working more than 40 hours a week, especially before releases. Tight deadlines are common. Adaptability and achievement orientation stand out as work styles, since designs change often after testing.

faq.q: What jobs are similar to video game designer?
faq.a: The closest are Graphic Designers (88% match), Special Effects Artists and Animators (82%) and Art Directors (76%), based on O*NET 31.0. Art Directors earn a median of $114,850, and animators earn $102,030, according to BLS May 2025 data.
